subject.title: Discord DMs: inbound messages silently dropped (outbound works)

question: Should Discord account-scoped allowFrom continue to narrow/replace root allowFrom for inbound DMs, or should root and account allowFrom be unioned?
rationale: The direct repair for this report broadens who may start Discord DM agent sessions on narrowed accounts, so code inspection alone should not choose the authorization contract.

options.title: Preserve Account Narrowing
options.body: Keep account-scoped allowFrom as the default security boundary and fix this issue through explicit per-account configuration, diagnostics, docs, or doctor guidance.

options.title: Union Root And Account Lists
options.body: Allow root-listed users through account DMs too, which addresses the reported root cause but broadens access for accounts that were intentionally narrowed.

options.title: Add Explicit Inheritance Policy
options.body: Introduce a documented opt-in inheritance mode only if maintainers want both root convenience and account-specific narrowing despite the extra config surface.

recommendation.title: Preserve Account Narrowing
recommendation.body: Keep account-scoped allowFrom as the default security boundary and fix this issue through explicit per-account configuration, diagnostics, docs, or doctor guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Discord account config, shared DM access helpers, and security-sensitive sender admission where recent history points most strongly to steipete.
